World Philosophy Day

images.alt:
World Philosophy Day is an international day proclaimed by UNESCO (the United Nations Educational, Scientitic and Cultural Organization) to honor and promote the importance of philosophy. It is celebrated every year on the third Thursday of November. The main aims of World Philosophy Day are to highlight the enduring value of philosophy for the development of human thought, encourage philosophical retlection on contemporary issues and the challenges of our time, promote critical, independent, and creative thought and foster dialogue, tolerance, and peace among individuals and societies.
On this day, organizations, academic institutions, and individuals around the world organize:
• Panel discussions
• Lectures and debates
• Workshops for students and the public
• Exhibitions and cultural events

Philosophy helps us question assumptions, stimulate debate, develop reasoning skills and broaden understanding of the world and ourselves.
